newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SiS Int'l delays 1996 earnings report.
newsitem.headline: SiS Int'l delays 1996 earnings report.

text.p: SIS International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had delayed the release of its final results announcement because its auditor could not complete the audit.
"The company will inform shareholders the revised date for announcement once it is confirmed by the auditor," it said in a statement.
The company said it was unable to annouce the 1996 final results as originally planned because the company's auditor Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu could not complete their audit.
The microcomputer products distributor was originally scheduled to release its 1996 final results on April 17.
